summary:
Phase B (capture) is done. Home and the listen / import / processing flow are built on the UI kit and the two engines, and verified end to end in headless Chrome against the dev server and the production build.

- **Home ('/', tab screen):**
  - Small 'Pauta' wordmark (TopBar large at 26 px); the Vinyl is the centered hero with the tonearm at rest. Tapping it opens /listen?mode=mic.
  - One line under it: 'Toca para escuchar'.
  - Quiet secondary pills: 'Archivo' (hidden audio/video input, decode with a loading state, toast on errors) and 'Pestaña' (only when isTabCaptureSupported).
  - 'Recientes': up to 8 ref-3-style cover cards with a glass caption (title + key), ordered by openedAt/updatedAt, linking to /score/:id.
  - preloadModel() runs when the browser is idle. Entrance motion is subtle.
  - A tiny localStorage hint picks the final layout from the first frame. Without it the vinyl visibly shrank ~0.7 s after load, when IndexedDB answered and the Recientes appeared.
  - Short phones (<780 px tall) give the hero the first screen; only the 'Recientes' title shows above the tab bar.
- **Record (/listen):**
  - XClose; large spinning Vinyl with the tonearm swinging in; thin progress ring = elapsed/max; LiveBars fed at 30 Hz through a tiny external store, so only the bars re-render.
  - Large tabular timer with a subtle max and a quiet recording dot; big neumorphic stop control (filled Untitled 'Stop' glyph).
  - States: starting, recording, stopping, idle (after 'Grabación demasiado corta', with a 'Grabar' button), permission denied and error (calm message + 'Reintentar').
  - Starts once, StrictMode-safe; releases the microphone on every exit. Auto-stops at settings.maxRecordSec. Haptic tick on start/stop.
  - The automatic start is deferred 520 ms: the engine's synchronous AudioContext constructor blocked the main thread 80-240 ms in the middle of the entrance.
- **Import:**
  - File tile (MusicNote01), or a small rounded muted video preview for video files; name and duration.
  - Waveform (computePeaks) with an accent trim frame. The handles sit outside the selected audio, so they never overlap; they are also keyboard sliders. The window can be dragged, and pressing the track pulls the nearest edge.
  - Rules: min 2 s, max 5 min, whole file if <= 2 min, otherwise the first 60 s.
  - Live selection length and range; Web Audio preview of the selection (the video plays muted in sync); accent 'Transcribir'. Redirects Home when the store is empty.
- **Processing:**
  - The vinyl spins slowly inside a ProgressRing with real progress, a spring-smoothed tabular percentage and one-word stages (Preparando / Escuchando / Escribiendo / Listo).
  - XClose cancels the worker and goes back.
  - 'No se detectaron notas' + 'Reintentar' returns to the trim (file) or to a new take (mic/tab). Errors show their Spanish message + 'Reintentar'.
  - A 700 ms success beat, then replace to /score/:id.
- **Pipeline (pipeline.ts):** toModelInput -> transcribe (imported only from engine/transcribe/index.ts) -> analyzeNotes -> defaultParams -> buildScore -> summarizeScore -> optional audio (file: encodeWav of the selected 22.05 kHz segment; mic/tab: the recorded blob) -> createScore, with cancellation. Also: a zustand capture store (store.ts), pure rules with 13 unit tests (selection.ts) and scripts/e2e-capture.mjs.
- **Same vinyl across screens:** layoutId cannot animate under AnimatePresence mode="wait". Instead, HeroVinyl does a measured FLIP of the record disc: Home -> Record glides and scales the turntable from where it was tapped (dy -81 px, scale 0.84 -> 1), and Record -> Processing slides the same disc (253 px) into the progress ring (252 px). It falls back to a scale/fade when no rect was remembered. Record and Processing use the kit's fade transition (Page variant 'tab') instead of the horizontal push slide, so the glide reads as one object.
- **Results:** scale.wav and scale.mp4 give 8 notes, C major, 100 ppm (matching the ground truth). The fake-mic take of melody-bass.wav gives 39-41 notes, G major, 110 ppm (also matching).
- **Client feedback:** docs/CLIENT-FEEDBACK.md had no entries at the start or at the end, so nothing to apply.
files: docs/screenshots/capture-*.png (16 new: home-empty, home, record, record-denied, import, import-video, processing, processing-empty; light + dark)
public_api_notes:
FLOW AND HISTORY
- '/' -> '/listen?mode=mic|tab' (push) -> '/processing' (replace) -> '/score/:id' (replace).
- '/' -> '/import' (push) -> '/processing' (push) -> '/score/:id' (replace).
- Back from the viewer:
  - file flow: returns to /import with the same file and selection (imported files stay in the capture store after success);
  - recordings: returns to Home (the store is reset after success).
- A reload on /import or /processing redirects Home.
- Page variants: Home is <Page variant="tab" tabBar>. Record and Processing use variant 'tab' (fade), not the push slide, for the vinyl continuity. Import is a push page with BottomBar.

CAPTURE STORE (src/features/capture/store.ts, zustand, not persisted)
- useCaptureStore / getCapture(): { source: 'mic'|'tab'|'file'|null, blob, name, mime, kind, decoded: DecodedMedia|null, range: {start, end}|null, setFile(file, decoded, range), setRecording(source, decoded, blob|null), setRange(range), reset() }.
- For mic/tab, the blob is kept only when settings.keepOriginalAudio.

PIPELINE (src/features/capture/pipeline.ts)
- startPipeline(input, onProgress?(progress 0..1 monotonic, stage 'preparing'|'listening'|'writing'|'done')) -> { promise: Promise<{status:'done', doc: ScoreDoc} | {status:'empty'}>, cancel() }.
  - input = { source, decoded, range, blob?, name?, settings: Pick<Settings,'sensitivity'|'minNoteMs'|'quantize'|'splitPoint'|'defaultDifficulty'|'keepOriginalAudio'> }.
  - cancel() rejects with AbortError (isAbortError(err) exported) and terminates the transcriber worker, which also drops the preloaded model.
  - Other errors: TranscriptionError messages from the engine, PipelineError PREPARE_ERROR_MESSAGE 'No se pudo preparar el audio.', SaveError SAVE_ERROR_MESSAGE 'No se pudo guardar la partitura.'.
- 'empty' = zero notes from the model, or zero notes after the default filters. No item is created.
- Saved ScoreDoc:
  - title: file name without extension, or defaultTitle('Grabación');
  - source 'mic'|'tab'|'file'; sourceName (files only); sourceKind (file: decoded.kind; recordings: 'audio');
  - durationSec = selection length; coverId = pickCoverId(id); favorite false;
  - notes in seconds relative to range.start; analysis = analyzeNotes(notes); params = defaultParams(analysis, settings); summary = summarizeScore(buildScore(...));
  - audioId when keepOriginalAudio:
    - file: 22.05 kHz mono 16-bit WAV of exactly the selected segment (the peak-normalized model input, starting at range.start, so score.startSeconds lines up);
    - mic/tab: the recorded blob as is (audio/webm;codecs=opus in Chrome, audio/mp4 in Safari).
  - If saving the audio fails, the item is still created without audio (console.warn).

HELPERS
- src/features/capture/selection.ts:
  - constants: MIN_SELECTION_SEC 2, MAX_SELECTION_SEC 300, WHOLE_FILE_MAX_SEC 120, DEFAULT_LONG_SELECTION_SEC 60, MIN_RECORDING_SEC 2;
  - functions: defaultSelection, minSelection, applySelectionEdit(prev, 'start'|'end'|'move', t, duration), normalizeSelection, titleFromFileName, STAGE_LABELS, overallProgress, stageFor.
- src/features/capture/util.ts: haptic(), useGoBack(fallback), useViewportSize() (width capped at 480), whenIdle(fn), and rememberHeroVinyl / peekHeroVinyl / forgetHeroVinyl.
- HeroVinyl (HeroVinyl.tsx): a FLIP of the '.ui-vinyl__record' rect between screens. Anyone can reuse it to make a vinyl continue from the previous screen: call rememberHeroVinyl(rootContainingAVinyl) before navigating, and wrap the next Vinyl in <HeroVinyl>.
- localStorage 'pauta.home.recents' ('1'/'0', try/catch): Home's first-frame layout hint. On a first run it is derived from DEMOS_SEEDED_KEY in src/data/seed.ts.

SELECTORS FOR E2E / INTEGRATION
- Home: vinyl [aria-label="Escuchar"] (role=button); input[type=file] (hidden, accept audio/*,video/*, use elementHandle.uploadFile); buttons 'Archivo' and 'Pestaña'; .home-card (Recientes).
- Record:
  - buttons [aria-label="Detener"] (enabled while recording), [aria-label="Grabar"] (idle after a too-short take), [aria-label="Cerrar"];
  - .cap-record__elapsed, .cap-record__bars;
  - .cap-record__message (denied/error) with a 'Reintentar' button.
  - The automatic start happens ~520 ms after mount.
- Import: .cap-import__name, .cap-import__media--video video; trim handles role=slider 'Inicio de la selección' / 'Fin de la selección' (arrows ±0.5 s, Shift ±5 s, PageUp/PageDown ±10 s, Home/End); a 'Transcribir' button.
- Processing: [aria-label="Cancelar"], .cap-proc__percent, .cap-proc__label, .cap-proc__message ('No se detectaron notas' + 'Reintentar').
- AnimatePresence mode="wait": a new screen mounts only after the old one's exit animation. Wait for selectors, not just for the hash.

E2E SCRIPT
- node scripts/e2e-capture.mjs [--url http://localhost:5185/] [--preview] [--headful]
  - Starts and stops its own server on the URL's port when none answers (--preview serves dist/).
  - Uses the fake mic (melody-bass.wav).
  - Reads items back with raw IndexedDB, so it works on dev and prod.
  - Writes a looped WAV to <os tmpdir>/pauta/e2e-capture for the cancel test.

requests.request: scripts/fixtures/check-bundle.mjs, 4th check ('the engine client spawns that worker chunk') now fails for a structural reason. Since the app imports src/engine/transcribe/index.ts too, Rolldown moves the shared engine client into its own chunk (assets/transcribe-*.js). That chunk does spawn worker-*.js, and the 0.3 KB probe chunk only imports it, so the check finds no spawn in the probe chunk. Checks 1-3 PASS, and the real dist build is clean (index-*.js has 0 tfjs markers and spawns worker-*.js). Suggested fix: look for the spawn in the chunk(s) the probe imports, e.g. const spawner = rows.find((r) => !workers.includes(r) && r.spawns); then check Boolean(spawner && workers[0]?.name.endsWith(spawner.spawns)). No app code layout can avoid the shared chunk.

Optional, recorder.ts (startLevelMeter):
(a) The AudioContext constructor is synchronous and blocked the main thread 80-240 ms here. Capture now starts recording 520 ms after the Record screen mounts, so the entrance is not frozen.
(b) Unverified on a device: Record auto-starts ~0.7 s after the user's tap, so the meter's AudioContext is created outside the gesture. On iOS Safari it may stay 'suspended' and the live bars would not move (recording itself is unaffected). Consider retrying ctx.resume() on the next pointerdown/touchend, or letting startRecording accept an AudioContext the caller unlocked inside the gesture.

docs/CONTINUAR.md section 4: mark 'Inicio + escuchar/importar/procesar' (capture) as done. For phase C: node scripts/e2e-capture.mjs (dev) and --preview (production) both give 6/6 PASS. check-bundle 4th check needs the engine-audio fix above.

known_issues: check-bundle.mjs reports FAIL on its 4th check only. This is a structural false negative, explained in requests; checks 1-3 PASS. npm run build emits assets/worker-CZJ-Xn9c.js (1.8 MB), and the main chunk has no tfjs code.

There is still a short blank moment between screens (AnimatePresence mode="wait", already listed for phase D).
- Measured on Home -> Record in the production build, after the model warm-up: frames stop for ~270 ms between Home's exit and Record's mount. The cost is native style/paint work (JS self time is small in the CPU profile), not app code.
- During the first seconds after load, the Basic Pitch warm-up on the GPU makes the stalls longer in headless Chrome.
- Once Record mounts, the vinyl glide runs smoothly at 13 ms per frame.
Possible iOS issue, not verified on a device: the live bars may stay still because the meter's AudioContext is created outside the user gesture (see requests).

Tab capture ('Pestaña') was not exercised end to end. Headless Chrome cannot pick a tab, and the button is hidden in the mobile-emulated screenshots by design: isTabCaptureSupported() is false on touch devices.
The waveform always shows the whole file, with no zoom. On very long files a 2 s selection is a few pixels wide; the handles stay usable because they sit outside the selected audio.

Files are decoded whole in memory. Files over 750 MB are refused with a toast. A 5-minute 48 kHz stereo file holds ~115 MB of PCM, and imported files stay in the capture store after a successful transcription (so Back returns to the trim) until the next capture or a reload.
Recordings get the title 'Grabación <fecha, hora>' (defaultTitle), including tab captures.
The fixture scale.mp4 has a flat lavender frame. The video-import screenshots use a demo clip built in my temp folder from the app's own hero photo plus piano fixture audio; it is not in the repo.
Changing settings.maxRecordSec while the Record screen is open restarts the take (the start callback depends on it). This cannot happen from the app's UI.
